construct_vector_envs_from_config: create a HabitatVectorEnvFactory and call construct_envs with a DictConfig to build a VectorEnv for multi-environment RL training
split_scenes_across_environments: build a scene splitting strategy that distributes scenes evenly across multiple environments using round-robin assignment
filter_measurements_by_rank: review how rank0_measure_names and rank0_env0_measure_names are filtered from task measurements for non-rank0 processes
create_threaded_debug_env: create a ThreadedVectorEnv by setting HABITAT_ENV_DEBUG=1 for slower but debuggable multi-environment execution
initialize_batch_renderer: run the batch renderer initialization on the VectorEnv when enable_batch_renderer is enabled in the simulator config
